name: Vapin Ape | 2g Full Spectrum Disposable | Pineapple Haze
description: Pineapple Haze, a remarkable sativa hybrid strain that harmoniously blends the flavors of tropical fruits, juicy pineapple, and refreshing citrus notes. This delightful flavor profile creates a captivating and invigorating experience that transports you to sun-drenched shores. Get ready to embrace a state of pure bliss as Pineapple Haze uplifts your spirits, fills you with an upbeat energy, and awakens a sense of joy and euphoria. Enhanced by the enchanting presence of Limonene, Ocimene, and Terpinolene terpenes, this strain offers a delightful fusion of aromas and effects that will leave you feeling revitalized and uplifted. Indulge in the tropical paradise of Pineapple Haze and let its euphoric embrace carry you to new heights of happiness and positivity. Taste & Aroma: Tropical, Pineapple, Citrus. Effect: Upbeat, Uplifted, Joyful
